nodes.label: Collapsed Sidebar Variant 2 - Admin Dashboard (Super Admin Workspace): shows the icon-only collapsed left rail (logo glyph, expand chevron, grid/dashboard icon highlighted with green active indicator dot, server/rack icon, people icon, terminal/logs icon, gear/settings icon, then a divider, user avatar 'HA', bell notification icon, and logout icon at the bottom). The main content area displays the 'Admin Dashboard' heading with date 'Tuesday, June 16, 2026', four KPI cards (Total Users 12,483 all time; Active Today 1,247 last 24h; New This Week 340 registrations; Services Running 6 live) each with a small teal-tinted icon badge, a 'User Growth' line/area chart card (30-day daily active users, +12.4% badge, teal gradient area chart trending upward), and a 'Service Usage' card listing active users per service as horizontal progress bars (Productivity 5,210, Portfolio 4,820, Photo 3,640, Drive 2,980). Differs from a typical collapsed-state screenshot by including the fully rendered dashboard content alongside the collapsed nav, demonstrating how the icon-only rail behaves in context with real page content and a visible active-state highlight plus expand chevron control.
